newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Emperor under pressure on 96/7 target.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Emperor under pressure on 96/7 target.

text.p: Fiji gold miner Emperor Mines Ltd said on Wednesday it was under pressure to reach its target production of 140,000 ounces in its current fiscal year (July/June) at its Vatukoula mine due to needed maintenance work.

A 12-day shutdown of mill operations starting May 7 is necessary to erect and commission a new crushing system, completing an expansion programme at the mine, Emperor said in a statement contained in its latest company newsletter to the Australian Stock Exchange.
Fourth quarter production is estimated by Emperor to reach at least 40,000 ounces.
